verdict.rationale: The only Ardent-native event-triggered automation is a per-connector option to run SQL on every new branch after it is created, which works as a post-creation hook. Per-PR branch creation is described, but it is driven by the user's CI harness rather than by rules defined in Ardent. missing for 10: a general rules/trigger engine, multiple event types (e.g., branch delete, schema change, replication status), webhooks or event notifications, configurable action types beyond SQL, and detailed docs or hands-on corroboration of the hook.
